task_description: In this scenario, the agents need to collaboratively handle a customer inquiry about a product return, escalate the issue if it's complex, and ensure the ticket status is updated correctly throughout the process.
expected_outcome: The customer inquiry is handled efficiently with all relevant information preserved during handoffs, complex issues are escalated, and the ticket status is updated in real-time without any data corruption.

agents.description: This agent handles the initial contact with the customer and gathers basic information to create a support ticket.
This agent handles more technical issues that the frontline agent cannot resolve and escalates issues if necessary.
This agent is responsible for updating the ticket status, ensuring it is synchronized across all systems, and tracking the resolution progress.
